verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.gitlab.com serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200, 'GitLab Documentation' index), so an agent can be pointed at it directly. GitLab also publishes agent-oriented guidance (the Orbit skill for AI coding agents) and a machine-readable, autogenerated OpenAPI 3.0 spec. Missing for 10: no evidence of the llms.txt's depth or coverage (e.g. a full-content variant or per-page markdown), and no independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively.
